# Operations Efficiency and Teller Performance Review

This document addresses critical operational improvements:

*   Urgent optimization of branch efficiency.
*   Quarterly review of customer wait times.
*   Review and update of customer wait times based on audit recommendations.
*   Update of teller performance metrics for Strategy 2026.
